description: Find EU legislation articles by meaning. Hits: law_id (CELEX), article_ref (use as articleId in lex_get_document), law_title, score, snippet. Consolidated hits (consolidated: true) are not authentic: quote them, cite baseCelex. asOf gives the text in force on a past date. Cost: 5 credits; with asOf, plus up to 5 per in-force version fetched live (default max 3 per call; failed fetches free).

asOf.description: The law as in force on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, 1952-01-01 to today) — use for questions about a past date. Hits then carry the version in force (asOfResolved: true, asOfVersion). Unresolved hits keep the CURRENT text with an asOfReason; follow asOfCaveat. Omit for current law.

filters.description: Pass-through to the semantic index. Today only "language" is honoured for legislation; other keys are ignored.

include.description: ["text"] returns the full matched article text instead of a ~600-character snippet.

language.description: Preferred language of the text (default en); acts without it come back in another language, labelled.

limit.description: Max hits (plan cap: FREE 10, STARTER 20, higher 50). Merged consolidated/base duplicates can make a page shorter.

maxChars.description: Character budget for hit texts when include is ["text"].

min_score.description: Similarity floor. Default ≈0.7 server-side; lower (0.5) when you got fewer hits than limit, 0 disables it.

query.description: Natural-language description of the provision you are looking for.

name: lex_semantic_legislation
title: Semantic search over EU legislation
